cause: Q1'24 revenue $33M at high end of outlook with resilient 57.9% non-GAAP gross margin; Q2'24 guidance of $40-42M implies 21-27% sequential growth, driven by hyperscaler AI datacenter demand (optical modules, smart NICs, switches, active cabling) and management said channel destocking is 'pretty much behind us'
quality: 经营性持续: AI datacenter timing-chip demand (800G->1.2-1.6T optical module transition, design wins already in hand) is a structural multi-year ramp, and the end of destocking removes a prior overhang, making the growth reacceleration credible rather than a one-off
reason: A genuine guide-up (21-27% sequential) tied to a real, identifiable AI-infrastructure design-win pipeline plus the end of a channel destocking cycle is a credible durable catalyst. Company has ample cash cushion ($517M) so the small negative FCF this quarter (OCF $1.7M vs capex $3M) is immaterial, not a capex-surge red flag. Automotive segment pricing pressure is a real but secondary offset.
red_flags: 汽车业务因EV市场不确定性面临定价压力(公司预期新产品设计可部分抵消);本季度小幅负自由现金流但规模小且现金充裕,不构成实质风险
